sections.text:
هذا 
المستند يوضح خطوات الفحص الشهري الخاص بأنظمة الاطفاء ( بودرة) المستخدمة 
فى 
سيارات الاطفاء.

أعد 
المسودة الأولية المهندس/ أحمد محمد المهتدي قمرة و اختبرها المهندس/ علاء محمد 
شاهين و راجعها المهندس/ السعيد شعبان عبد القادر ووافق عليها السيد المهندس/ محمد 
صبرى زيدان مدير عام شئون المحطة و اعتمدها السيد المهندس/ أحمد عبد المجيد صوان رئيس قطاع محطة توليد كهرباء النوبارية.

راجعها ووافق على المستند المهندس/ مدحت محمد خاطر مفتش السلامة و الصحة المهنية 
بقطاع التفتيش و مراقبة الجودة 
ووافق على المستند المهندس/ سمير عبد الجليل أحمد مدير عام التفتيش الفني بشركة وسط الدلتا لانتاج الكهرباء 
ومنسق الشركة لنظام 
معلومات اجراءات الصيانة ووثق 
من السيد المهندس/ محمد نجيب عبد الحي رئيس قطاع التفتيش و مراقبة الجودة بشركة وسط الدلتا لانتاج الكهرباء.

items:
اتباع اجراءات السلامة و الصحة المهنية للأفراد 
 و المعدات و ارتداء مهمات الوقاية الشخصية (خوذة آمان- حذاء آمان اوفرول- 
 جوانتي.......).

sections.text:
الإجراءات المطلوب تنفيذها
اولا : اجراءات عامة 
:

rows: التأكد من تجربة تشغيل سيارة الاطفاء و صلاحيتها
التأكد من أن السرينة تعمل
التأكد من أن الفلاشر يعمل

ثانيا: نظام الاطفاء بالبودرة 
 الكيميائية الجافة 
 :
التأكد من سلامة جسم خزان البودرة و التأكد من عدم وجود تآكل أو ثقوب .

التاكد 
 من ملء خزان البودرة.
لتأكد من ملء اسطوانات النيتروجين (الترصيص-القياس-الوزن).
التأكد من سلامة الخراطيم والقواذف يمين وشمال .
التأكد من سلامة العدادات.
تقليب البودرة داخل الخزان
فتح البلف الخاص باسطوانات النيتروجين.
فتح البلوف المؤدية الى خزان البودرة.
التأكد من الضغط داخل خزان البودرة.

فتح 
بلوف الطرد للبودرة و تجربة استخدام نظام البودرة من أحد قواذف البودرة .
التأكد من أن زمن الاطفاء بالبودرة في الحدود المسموح بها.

عمل نظافة لمسار البودرة عن طريق غلق البلون المؤدية الى خزان البودرة و بذلك يكون 
مسار الغاز من اسطوانة النيتروجين حتى القاذف.

اعادة 
النظام كسابقه و التأكد من أن ضغط اسطوانتى 
النيتروجين مثالى .

ثالثا: 
 ملحقات سيارة الاطفاء 
 :

التأكد من وجود بدل مقاومة للحريق بمشتملاتها 
 .
التاكد من وجود جهاز تنفس صناعي وصلاحيته.
التأكد من وجود معدات الانقاذ (أحبال- مقص- عتلة- بلطة......)
التأكد من صلاحية السلم الخاص بسيارة الاطفاء.

sections_en.text: This document outlines the steps of the monthly inspection of the powder fire-fighting systems used in fire trucks.

The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Alaa Mohamed Shaheen, reviewed by Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader, accepted by Eng. Mohamed Sabry Zidan, General Manager of Station Affairs, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of El-Nubaria Power Station Sector.

The document was reviewed and approved by Eng. Medhat Mohamed Khater, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil Ahmed, General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.

items: Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment, and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet — safety shoes, overalls, gloves...).

sections_en.text:
Procedures to be Carried Out
First: General procedures 
:

rows: Make sure to test-run the fire truck and check that it is in working order.
Make sure the siren works.
Make sure the flasher works.

Second: Dry chemical powder fire-fighting system 
 :
Make sure the powder tank body is sound and that there is no corrosion or holes.
Make sure the powder tank is filled.
Make sure the nitrogen cylinders are filled (sealing — measurement — weighing).
Make sure the hoses and nozzles, right and left, are sound.
Make sure the gauges are sound.
Stir the powder inside the tank.
Open the valve of the nitrogen cylinders.
Open the valves leading to the powder tank.
Make sure of the pressure inside the powder tank.
Open the powder discharge valves and test the use of the powder system from one of the powder nozzles.
Make sure the powder fire-fighting time is within the permitted limits.
Clean the powder path by closing the valves leading to the powder tank, so that the gas path runs from the nitrogen cylinder to the nozzle.
Return the system to its previous state and make sure the pressure of the two nitrogen cylinders is ideal.

Third: 
 Fire truck accessories 
 :
Make sure fire-resistant suits with their accessories are present.
Make sure a breathing apparatus is present and in working order.
Make sure rescue equipment is present (ropes — shears — crowbar — axe...).
Make sure the fire truck ladder is in working order.

Introduction
This document outlines the steps of the monthly inspection of the powder fire-fighting systems used in fire trucks.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Alaa Mohamed Shaheen, reviewed by Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader, accepted by Eng. Mohamed Sabry Zidan, General Manager of Station Affairs, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Meguid Sawan, Head of El-Nubaria Power Station Sector.
The document was reviewed and approved by Eng. Medhat Mohamed Khater, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection and Quality Control Sector, and approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Gelil Ahmed, General Manager of Technical Inspection at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's Maintenance Procedure Information System coordinator, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment, and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet — safety shoes, overalls, gloves...).
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
2 m long powder stirring rod
Vehicle tool bag
Cleaning tools
2 m long powder stirring rod
Procedures to be Carried Out
First: General procedures 
:
1. | Make sure to test-run the fire truck and check that it is in working order.
2. | Make sure the siren works.
3. | Make sure the flasher works.
Second: Dry chemical powder fire-fighting system 
 :
1. | Make sure the powder tank body is sound and that there is no corrosion or holes.
2. | Make sure the powder tank is filled.
3. | Make sure the nitrogen cylinders are filled (sealing — measurement — weighing).
4. | Make sure the hoses and nozzles, right and left, are sound.
5. | Make sure the gauges are sound.
6. | Stir the powder inside the tank.
7. | Open the valve of the nitrogen cylinders.
8. | Open the valves leading to the powder tank.
9. | Make sure of the pressure inside the powder tank.
10. | Open the powder discharge valves and test the use of the powder system from one of the powder nozzles.
11. | Make sure the powder fire-fighting time is within the permitted limits.
12. | Clean the powder path by closing the valves leading to the powder tank, so that the gas path runs from the nitrogen cylinder to the nozzle.
13. | Return the system to its previous state and make sure the pressure of the two nitrogen cylinders is ideal.
Third: 
 Fire truck accessories 
 :
1. | Make sure fire-resistant suits with their accessories are present. 
 
2. | Make sure a breathing apparatus is present and in working order.
3. | Make sure rescue equipment is present (ropes — shears — crowbar — axe...).
4. | Make sure the fire truck ladder is in working order.
